mapping_json.fidelity_notes: THE totem-channel archetype at its purest ('never press a damage button — place totems and reposition', mech_note). Geometry both-native: circle (expanding-circle detonation) delivered via totem proxies. Stage-channel = accumulator (charge_stack_sub_shape); the CHANNEL itself lives on the proxy, so the player-side commit stays instant (corpus commit_val=instant is the PLAYER's experience — engine-consistent). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — doors routed from proxy identity: PROXY_ASCENSION (totem-hiero register, section-5) + PROXY_CONVERGENCE (2-4 clustered totems with overlapping blast coverage; golementalist b03 precedent). Stage->radius live growth filed as ACCRUAL #2 to the b02 crackling-lance stack-driven-geometry-morph qualitative candidate (kit graded as-if-un-minted). Era 3.0-3.6.

mints_anchored.description: Stack-parameterizes-geometry: an accumulator whose stack count reshapes the skill's LIVE geometry/emission, not just its damage. Three attested bindings: intensity-stacks narrow+intensify a beam (crackling-lance); stacks morph placed-AoE arc coverage (pizza-sticks); stored catch-count sets release projectile COUNT (venom-gyre). Engine accumulator scales magnitude only.
